column1: # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Pinned third-party maps, fetched into maps/ by scripts/fetch-maps.sh (the
# .bsp files are gitignored; the Containerfile overlays maps/ at build time).
# Tab-separated; one row per map. Every row needs a license/permission note:
# record the author's redistribution terms before adding a map to FastDL
# (docs/cstrike/maps/). Use `unknown-no-fastdl` when terms are unclear; the
# server can still offer it through its slow built-in download.
# extras (optional): comma-separated custom files from the same zip, under
# sound/ only, that the map needs; `-` for none.
# fastdl: `yes` only once the author's terms allow re-hosting. This column
# is the redistribution allowlist. scripts/cleared-maps.sh is the only
# reader: `just fastdl`, the published image build and the CI check all
# use it. Anything other than `yes` (or a missing column) keeps the map out
# of FastDL and out of a published image. A private build (MAP_POLICY=local)
# can still include it. tests/mapcycle_test.sh fails if a map that is not
# cleared is found under docs/cstrike/.
# NIPPER's maps: author-uploaded "NIPPER maps - Complete pack" (one 242 MB zip,
# downloaded once and cached). CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: credit NIPPER, no commercial
# use, no modified BSPs. GameBanana's checklist asks that we get permission
# before re-hosting elsewhere, so these stay off FastDL until NIPPER agrees.
# Climb maps (MODE=climb): every one has the standard timer buttons
# (func_button targets counter_start / counter_off) and needs nothing beyond
# its .bsp. None of the archives carries licence text. GameBanana shows its
# default CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 on almost every map page, re-uploads by other people
# included, so it counts as the author's terms only on the author's own upload
# (bkz_toonworld, kz_climbers_b01). All stay off FastDL until an author agrees.
# Looked at and left out: kz_longjumps2 and kz_kzarg_toonbhop (no timer
# buttons), kz_egypt_hz (the one map whose author allows redistribution, but
# .rar only, with custom models and sprites the fetcher does not extract).
# Surf maps (MODE=surf): none has timer buttons (the timer uses zones, see
# movement.sma) and each needs only its .bsp. surf_nice_fly_4's author chose
# CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 on the map page, which allows sharing with credit; it stays
# off FastDL like the rest until the stricter rule above is revisited. Left
# out: surf_ski_2, surf_green and surf_egypt (.rar only), surf_water-run (a
# custom sprite), surf_ninja (a sound the archive does not contain).
# Not pinned yet: ka_monkeybars (knife arena) ships without a bot .nav, and
# ZBot would generate one at map load (very slow under qemu). Generate it once
# on an x86 host (`bot_nav_generate`), then add a row and a mapcycle entry.
